name: ImageList
description: Lista de imágenes: rejilla regular (`standard`), acolchada con piezas de distinto tamaño (`quilted`), tejida (`woven`) o en mampostería (`masonry`), con título opcional encima o debajo.

props.name: items
props.type: { src, alt, title?, subtitle?, cols?, rows?, width?, height?, href? }[]

a11y: ul con nombre; cada imagen con su alt y carga diferida (loading=lazy, decoding=async). El título es texto, no parte de la imagen. En `masonry` el orden de lectura es el del marcado, columna a columna.

examples.title: Acolchada
examples.code: <ImageList variant="quilted" columns={4} rowHeight={120} label="Trips" items={[{ src: "https://picsum.photos/seed/zuix0/600/400", alt: "Mountain lake at dawn", title: "Lake", cols: 2, rows: 2 }, { src: "https://picsum.photos/seed/zuix1/600/400", alt: "Desert dunes", title: "Dunes" }, { src: "https://picsum.photos/seed/zuix2/600/400", alt: "City at night", title: "City" }, { src: "https://picsum.photos/seed/zuix3/600/400", alt: "Forest path", title: "Forest", cols: 2 }, { src: "https://picsum.photos/seed/zuix4/600/400", alt: "Coastline", title: "Coast" }, { src: "https://picsum.photos/seed/zuix5/600/400", alt: "Snowy peaks", title: "Peaks" }]} />

origin: Image List (standard, quilted, woven, masonry) de MUI y Material.
